This Crl.P Is Filed U/S.482 Cr.P.C Praying To Quash The
Fir In Cr.No.146/2021 Dated 14.12.2021 Registered By The
First Respondent Police Against The Petitioner For The
Offence P/U/S.420, 417, 463, 464, 468, 471 Of Ipc Based On The
Complaint Lodged By Second Respondent And The
Proceedings Arising There From.
 This Crl.P, Coming On For Admission, This Day, Order
Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs Justice M G Uma
 Oral Order
Petitioners being accused Nos.1 to 4 in Cr.No.146/2021 of Buntwala Town police station, on the file
of the learned Additional Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.) and Jmfc., Court, Buntwala Nc: 2025:Khc:702
Town, are seeking to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against them for the offences
punishable under Sections 417, 420, 463, 464, 468, 471 of Indian Penal Code (for short 'the Ipc').

2 . Brief facts of the case are that, respondent No.2 as complainant filed the first information against
accused No.1 to 4 with Buntwala Town Police alleging that his mother is the owner of 6 guntas of
land comprising in Sy.No.83/24 and 93/25C1 situated at Amtady village of Buntwala Taluk as the

2

same was granted in her favour.
The revenue records were standing in her name.

The complainant
being the son and other family members together were enjoying the property.

It is stated that
accused Nos.1 and 2 were intending to form a road adjacent to the land belonging to the mother of
the complainant and finally they are successful in getting her consent.

Taking advantage of her
advanced age and illiteracy, the accused have taken the signatures of the mother of the complainant
on blank papers and concocted a document styled as sale deed in respect of 6 guntas of land.

Recently, when record of rights of the property in question were verified, the complainant came to
know regarding the sale deed got created Nc: 2025:Khc:702 by the accused.

On enquiry, the
mother of the complainant has informed that she never executed any such sale deed.

Therefore, it is
alleged that the petitioners taking advantage of the helpless condition of the mother of the
complainant, got concocted the sale deed by forging the document, committed criminal breach of
trust and cheating.
Therefore, he requested the police to register the case and to initiate legal action.
Accordingly, police have registered the case and took up investigation.
3. In the meantime, petitioners being accused Nos.1 to 4 are before this Court seeking to quash the
criminal
proceedings
initiated against them

. The petitioners got the interim order staying the
further proceedings in the matter and therefore, the investigation was not undertaken.
4. Heard Sri.Ravishankar Shastry.G., learned counsel for the petitioners.

Smt. Rashmi Patel, learned
High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1. and Amar Correa, learned counsel for
respondent No.2.
Perused the materials on record.

In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsel for both the parties, the point that
would arise for my consideration is:
"Whether the Petitioners have made out any grounds to allow the petition and to
quash the criminal proceedings initiated against them?"

My answer to the above point is in 'Affirmative' for the following:
Reasons
6.

The facts of the case are that 6 guntas of land comprised in Sy.No.83/24 and 93/25C1 situated at
Amtady village of Buntwala Taluk was granted in favour of the mother of the complainant is not in
dispute.
Thus, she was the absolute owner in possession and enjoyment of the property.

It is the
contention of accused No.1 that mother of the complainant executed an absolute sale deed on
30.07.2018 and sold the property in question in his favour for a valid consideration.

To evidence
that fact, he has produced copy of the registered sale deed.

It is stated that the mutation of the name
of accused No.1 was effected in the revenue records and thus, he was in Nc: 2025:Khc:702
possession and enjoyment of the property.

But it is the contention of respondent No.2 that his
mother never executed any sale deed.

Taking advantage of her advanced age and illiteracy, the
petitioners got concocted the sale deed by forging her signatures without paying any consideration

sentences.text:

3

amount.

Strangely, the mother of the complainant had never raised any objection regarding the sale
deed in question.
She is not the complainant, who filed the complaint making any allegations.

The
only allegation found in the complaint made by respondent No.2 is that he enquired with her
mother and she said that she has not executed any of those document, only based on such say of his
mother, respondent No.2 appears to have filed the first information.

Admittedly, the mother of the
complainant
was alive when the complaint was filed.
It is stated that she is still alive.

But neither the
executant of the sale nor respondent No.2 chose to file a Civil Suit to avoid the registered sale deed,
which is in favour of accused No.1.

Under such circumstances, I am of the opinion that respondent
No.2, who is not having any right over the property has filed the criminal complaint invoking the
penal provisions by abusing the process of law.

Hence, the Nc: 2025:Khc:702 criminal proceedings
against the petitioners is liable to be quashed.

7. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the Affirmative and proceed to pass the following:
Order
(i) The petition is allowed.
(ii) The Fir registered against the petitioners in Cr.No.146/2021 of Buntwala Town
police station, for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 420, 463, 464, 468 and
4

71 of IPC, on the file of the learned Additional Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.) and JMFC.,
Court, Buntwala Town, is hereby quashed.

SD/-
